newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range in slow trading today on a lack of market-moving news.
"Members began to do less business with the approach of the year-end," said one trader. "The rates are likely to move narrowly in the short term if there is no major news."

Traders said the only foreseeable big news would be a cut in bank reserve ratios in the short term, as promised by the central bank. If the cut was announced, it would push down the rates by about 1.00 percentage point on average, they said.
